channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Karl-Anthony Towns | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Karl-Anthony Towns from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“Before I played with Karl-Anthony Towns I called him soft too,before I played with him. But when I left from playing with him, he's just so skilled. When I mean skilled, he's one of those players that when it's time to warm up before the game, he only need like five shots. He's played basketball for so long. He had his dad as a coach, so if you have a coach's son in the gym and he's been playing basketball since sixth grade with his dad and all that, basketball is easy. You don't need to be tough.”

Patrick Beverley on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jun 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“I’ll blame it on lacking the leader to show them that ‘hey, this is what you do. Not walk off.’ I blame it on that.“There’s a way to win and there’s a way to lose. And walking off the court, not looking your killer in his eyes, ain’t the way to lose…I hate it. I hate when people do it. And I hated to see those young Spurs do it because I actually think they’re capable of doing something special…and I would urge those young Spurs [to] reach out to Jalen Brunson however you can. Reach out to Karl-Anthony Towns however you can. Reach out to Josh Hart, however you can. You tell [those] dudes ‘congratulations.’”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson, Jun 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Jay Williams on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Jay Willams says Mitch Johnson game plan was poor:

“Nor do I think it was executed correctly. Number one, why is Wemby guarding Karl-Anthony Towns putting pressure on the ball 25 feet away from the basket? Why not just stand at the three point line be tall, be wide, deny passing lanes. Karl-Anthony Towns wants to drive and I guess you can question him if whether he would do it. But if anything you want Karl-Anthony Towns settled to shoot three after three thats playing into what you want.”

Jay Williams on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jun 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Starks on William Wesley, Leon Rose, Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“They understand what it takes. We’ve got a great leader in Jalen [Brunson] and Karl-Anthony Towns. I’m excited about it. “These are such even-keeled individuals. All those guys. I think Leon [Rose] and [William Wesley] did a great job putting together like-minded individuals. And that’s what it takes. Guys that are not gonna get too high, get too low, and they cheer for one another and they like one another. That’s what it takes, to have that togetherness, because things can get tough. You got to know who’s in the same boat as you. You don’t want to see guys jumping ship. And these guys don’t jump ship. If the boat’s gonna go down, they’re gonna go down together.”

John Starks on William Wesley, Leon Rose, Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson, May 26, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Now one thing Karl-Anthony Towns can't do is call me a front-runner. Um, his voice changes too much to call someone a front-runner. Um, 'cause we don't really know which KAT we gettin’. In saying that, um, for those that watched that Knicks game — I was talking the whole game. Um, I always talk the whole game when I’m in that mode. And I was definitely in that mode coming out, as you could see by the first post-up. And he tried to back down and the wall didn’t move. And he tried to back down and the wall didn’t move. And then he tried to — ahhh — and the wall doesn’t move. So the 7-foot, 290-pounder versus the 6'7”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jan 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“They got some guys who can just make some hellacious shots.(Karl-Anthony Towns) and (Jalen Brunson) did that last game. I felt like those were kind of taking the air out of us. We were kind of sighing after every one, walking the ball up. Today we’re trying to keep poking on. Who cares? Let’s get it in, and let’s run. Go right back at them. They’re going to make shots. Let’s just keep going.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson, May 28, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on whether or not Karl-Anthony Towns needs to take more shots:

“When there’s a 2nd and 3rd defender coming, I don’t want him to try to shoot over 3 people. I want him to make a pass. If he does that, he’s helping his team.”

Tom Thibodeau on Karl-Anthony Towns, May 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Tom Thibodeau, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Brunson said after practice on Friday.

“Individually, he’s meant a lot to my career. He’s meant a decent amount to [Karl-Anthony Towns], coaching KAT in Minnesota and here. There’s a lot of players who can say they’ve definitely benefited from Tom Thibodeau in his career. “But I think as a team, we’re always in a position where we can compete in the postseason, since I’ve been here. He’s very prepared, he’s a very prepared individual. He’s done a lot for my career, so I’m always going to be a supporter. Always. Even when he annoys me, always.”

Jalen Brunson on Tom Thibodeau, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 18, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I’m not the guy that’s going to say when someone does something wrong and not say when they do something right. That mentality that Karl-Anthony Towns came out with — it’s the exact mentality that he should have come out with, and I loved it.”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Mar 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“No, I’mma tell you — I’m going to tell you what he said, BD, because I think this was a big moment for Towns in my opinion. And I’m going to go more into why I think it was a big moment, but I’m going to tell you what he said.”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Mar 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“On top of that, no one has told Thibs – including the players. If I’m Karl-Anthony Towns or I’m (Jalen Brunson), I’m pulling Thibs in the room and I’m saying, ‘Listen.’ It’s a players league, they can get this off. Thibs so stubborn, though, that I don’t know. But it’s going to have to be something. Because you can’t go up against the Bostons, the Clevelands and not have a bench.”

Kevin Garnett on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson, Jan 17, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Conley on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Chris Hine:Mike Conley on what he misses about Karl-Anthony Towns:

“The energy he brought every day, just playful sometimes, sometimes it’s super smart, witty, whatever it may be, being funny. Just being himself. He wasn’t trying to be anybody else but himself, but you respect that about him. Comes in every day, and does that. It's something that you get used to, and when they leave, it’s like dang you miss those moments you see every day in practice.”

Mike Conley on Karl-Anthony Towns, Dec 17, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: OG Anunoby on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
James Edwards III:OG Anunoby on Karl-Anthony Towns’ season:

“I don't think he's exceeded expectations. We've been playing against him for years.”

OG Anunoby on Karl-Anthony Towns, Dec 17, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Zach LaVine on facing new-look Knicks with Karl-Anthony Towns:

“He gives them a lot of offense. Hopefully I can talk a little trash to him, throw him off his game. Say some old words to him, see if it makes him miss a couple 3s.”

Zach LaVine on Karl-Anthony Towns, Nov 12, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Jimmy Butler, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Bam Adebayo on whether Jimmy Butler is fired up to face Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I don’t think he gets fired up for matchups. I think if they start it, that’s when it starts. He’ll feel like – he’ll see something, and he just digs in.... He’ll see body language, something small and just goes with it.”

Bam Adebayo on Jimmy Butler, Karl-Anthony Towns, Oct 30, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau:

“Julius Randle and Donte DiVincenzo added a lot to our team. We had a need at the center position…. To get a player of (Karl-Anthony Towns') stature was huge. You don’t get a player like that without giving good players up.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo, Oct 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Kyrie Irving on Karl-Anthony Towns:

“Despite the unfair criticism that he's received, he's a great player. I respect him. I know my teammates respect him... That's what great players do. They figure it out.”

Kyrie Irving on Karl-Anthony Towns, May 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Nikola Jokic, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the job Karl-Anthony Towns did guarding Nikola Jokic:

“I think the main thing today was his ass stayed out of foul trouble, like I told him in Phoenix. That was all that was. Yeah, I mean I cussed him out. I cuss him out every chance I get. Bro, stop fucking fouling. I think you guys see it, if KAT don’t foul we pretty much can win the game every time. Tonight he had three fouls, but he only had three, he didn’t have five. I told him today, ‘We thankful that you didn’t foul because if you foul we lose, because you the best matchup we’ve got for Jokic, like you do the best job on him. I mean we’re coming to double but you do the best job standing up to his first dribble.’ He did that tonight.”

Anthony Edwards on Nikola Jokic, Karl-Anthony Towns, May 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Marcus Smart, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
“Marcus Smart, you won DPOY, you guard Steph [Curry], right?… There’s a center who won [it] and we're asking Karl-Anthony Towns to go guard the center.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Marcus Smart, Karl-Anthony Towns, May 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the impact of Karl-Anthony Towns in Game 1:

“He played the game clean. He played it the right way. He defended very well, and he did everything we needed him to do. He rebounded. He spread the floor. He got to the corner. He wasn’t cutting when he didn’t need to. He did everything tonight, and like I said, to me, he’s still the reason we won. First half, I was nonexistent. He carried us on his back, so, yeah, thank you KAT.”

Anthony Edwards on Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Kevin Durant on making Rudy Gobert and Karl-Anthony Towns work defensively:

“Rudy’s gotten extremely better at guarding perimeters, guarding posts, guarding the rim. So you can’t just throw ‘em in actions expecting them to just give in. I think we’ll be strategic with what we do”

Kevin Durant on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Chris Finch on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Chris Finch on stylistic changes that could happen in Karl-Anthony Towns' absence:

“Certainly last year when KAT was out, we kinda morphed into this exclusively spread pick and roll team, and we found a good rhythm there. I still would like to do some of the things that we have been doing. I think with Naz in there, it gives us opportunities to still do that, particularly with the season he's had and the growth he's had. There's a lot of things we can kinda twin up with what KAT does and what he does. So yeah, I don't want to abandon some of the other things completely, but I do believe we might get a little faster. But we'll see.”

Chris Finch on Karl-Anthony Towns, Mar 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Jon Krawczynski on Las Vegas, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski on Karl-Anthony Towns:

“He he said it several times, both publicly and privately as well as that he could just feel that that calf was not where it needed to be. And when I caught up with him in Las Vegas, he said that he was feeling fully healthy again, for the first time since before he was injured.”

Jon Krawczynski on Las Vegas, Karl-Anthony Towns, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“All series, Aaron Gordon, his defense on Karl-Anthony Towns. I can't leave this press conference without giving Aaron a lot of love and respectfor the defense he played.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Karl-Anthony Towns' big second half (17 points, 4/4 from 3):

“That’s Karl, man. That’s what he do. I told him, ‘Go out there and be you.’ Can’t nobody stop him. Can’t nobody stop you. That’s what he did. I love him, that’s my brother.”

Anthony Edwards on Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: LeBron James on Mike Conley, Karl-Anthony Towns, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“When you got guys like KAT [Karl-Anthony Towns] and Anthony Edwards, those guys can both go for 40 against you. ... You have a very cerebral, solid point guard in Mike Conley who's been in multiple playoff games. So, listen, we know what we're getting ourselves into.”

LeBron James on Mike Conley, Karl-Anthony Towns, Anthony Edwards, Apr 9, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Dane Moore:Chris Finch on how Rudy Gobert's role changes with Karl-Anthony Towns out:

“I don’t think it changes all the much, to be honest with you... We might be able to find him a bit more as a rolling threat, open up some opportunities there. But I don’t think it changes drastically.”

Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns, Dec 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Poeltl on Sochan:

“He was great today. He was aggressive on defense on Karl-Anthony Towns. He was aggressive on offense trying to look for his shots, he's looking very comfortable already. If he can keep that up, that aggressiveness, that's great for us.”

Jakob Poeltl on Karl-Anthony Towns, Jeremy Sochan, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Dane Moore:Rudy Gobert on Karl-Anthony Towns:

“What I love about Karl is that he really wants to see people around him have fun and people around him win. As a star player in this league, it's a great threat, and I think it's a trait winning players have.”

Rudy Gobert on Karl-Anthony Towns, Oct 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Dane Moore:Chris Finch on staying big in the playoffs, playing Rudy Gobert and Karl-Anthony Towns together:

“Certainly teams tend to go small in the playoffs, but we’re not. We’re not doing that. We’re going to have to figure out a way that all these things work.”

Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.
